facts.title: Learn Enchanting
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. No starting zone has an Enchanting Supply vendor: the Copper Rod and Mote of Magic for the first points are sold beside Jhag in the Drag, Orgrimmar. Disenchant is in the Enchanting box of the Professions window, not the spellbook.

facts.title: Learn Enchanting
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Elwynn Forest has no Enchanting trainer. The trainer page puts her in the Canals, the guide in the Mage Quarter. The Enchanting Supply vendor stands beside her. Disenchant is in the Enchanting box of the Professions window, not the spellbook.

facts.title: Enchanting 1-70: Runed Copper Rod, then bracers
facts.note: 1-2: Runed Copper Rod (Copper Rod and Mote of Magic, both from the Enchanting Supply vendor, not the Auction House). 2-20: 18 Enchant Bracer - Inferior Stamina (a Mote of Magic each). 20-70: 50 Enchant Bracer - Minor Deflect (Lesser Magic Essence) or 50 Enchant Chest - Inferior Stamina (Strange Dust). Forever's new low recipes make these points cheaper than in Classic.

facts.title: Enchanting 70-150: chest and weapon enchants
facts.note: With essences: 70-109 Enchant Chest - Minor Absorption; 110-150 Enchant 2H Weapon - Lesser Intellect (formula from Kithas in Orgrimmar or Tilli Thistlefuzz in Ironforge). With dust: 70-100 Enchant Bracer - Minor Stamina; 100-130 Enchant Cloak - Minor Protection; 130-150 Enchant Boots - Minor Stamina. 109-110 either way: Runed Silver Rod (a Blacksmith's Silver Rod and a Shadowgem).

facts.title: Expert Enchanting is in Stonetalon
facts.location: Hgarth, on the hill above Sun Rock Retreat, Stonetalon Mountains
facts.note: Needs Enchanting 125 and level 20; 50 silver. He is the only Horde Expert trainer.

facts.title: Expert Enchanting is in Elwynn Forest
facts.location: Kitta Firewind, top of the Tower of Azora, Elwynn Forest
facts.note: Needs Enchanting 125 and level 20; 50 silver. Vanessa Sellers in Dalaran is also listed, but the trainer page says she may be bugged in the beta.
